tools.name: get_account
tools.description:
Get the connected Siren workspace: plan, key scopes, auto-post
setting, and daily limit. Call this first to learn what the account
can do before generating. Empty asset_types / channels /
connected_accounts lists mean UNRESTRICTED, not missing — never stop
on them. Films render on every plan; credit

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description:
List the workspace's generation runs (newest first): status, brief,
channel, asset URLs, and caption. Page with offset to see them all.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description:
Get one run by id — full status, output text, asset URLs,
caption, and any error. Poll this after create_campaign
or render_asset until status is terminal. Wait `poll_after_seconds`
between polls; `progress` and `eta_seconds` say how far along it is.
A finished film carries `film_check`, advice only

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description:
Create a Siren campaign from a plain-language brief — the full
pipeline: plan, on-brand copy, deterministic render, verify. Returns
the run; poll get_run until it finishes. Spends credits (image 10,
video 25; voice or music-only is the same 25). Pass output_type to
pin a film (list_films has the cat

tools.name: render_asset
tools.description:
Render pre-formed SirenSeed bodies directly (advanced): deterministic
template render, no planner. Each item: {output_type, channel,
seed_body, archetype?, family?, surface?, caption?, voice_id?}.
Prefer create_campaign unless the user has concrete seed JSON.
Returns run ids — poll get_run for statu

tools.name: post_run
tools.description:
Post a finished run's assets to the workspace's CONNECTED SOCIAL
ACCOUNT. This is live, public distribution on the customer's channel
— always confirm with the user before calling. Only works if the
grant was authorised with posting allowed.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description:
Schedule a finished run to post at scheduled_at (ISO-8601).
Shows in the customer's local timezone. platforms: x, instagram,
tiktok, linkedin, youtube, or everything. Posts fire sequentially.
Requires Allow posting. Prefer this over post_run when the user
names a time. On create_campaign you can pas

tools.name: get_brand_dna
tools.description:
Get this workspace's Brand DNA: name, overview, tagline, offer,
features, products, audience, palette, logos. Not Brand Memory.

tools.name: update_brand_dna
tools.description:
Patch Brand DNA. Send only keys to change. Nested bags (offer,
product_map, icp) merge. Examples: {tagline, overview,
offer: {product_name, one_liner, features, who_its_for, primary_cta},
product_map: {offerings, how_we_work}, icp: {who_buys, pains}}.
Does not read or write Brand Memory.

tools.name: list_product_screens
tools.description:
List the brand assets in Brand DNA: product photos, app screenshots,
packaging. Each row has name, kind, description, use_when, tags,
scan_status (scanning / ready / failed), device, theme, url.

tools.name: upload_product_screen
tools.description:
Upload a brand asset (product photo, app screenshot, packaging) into
Brand DNA and store it on R2. Pass image_url (https PNG/JPG/WebP) or
image_base64.

Two ways to file it:
- Send `description` (and optionally kind, use_when, tags, name): Siren
  trusts your words and files the asset as-is. No read

tools.name: update_product_screen
tools.description:
Edit an existing brand asset: name, description, kind, use_when,
and the screenshot tags (screen_type, device, theme).

tools.name: delete_product_screen
tools.description: Remove a product screenshot from Brand DNA. Does not delete Brand Memory.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "post_run" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Post a finished run's assets to the workspace's CONNECTED SOCIAL ACCOUNT. This is live, public distribution on the customer's channel — always confirm with the …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, list_runs, get_run, list_product_screens · Private data: upload_product_screen · Public sink: get_account, create_campaign, post_run, schedule_post, update_brand_dna, upload_product_screen · Destructive: get_run, create_campaign, render_asset, post_run, schedule_post, delete_product_screen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, list_runs, get_run, list_product_screens · Private data: upload_product_screen · Public sink: get_account, create_campaign, post_run, schedule_post, update_brand_dna, upload_product_screen · Destructive: get_run, create_campaign, render_asset, post_run, schedule_post, delete_product_screen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

labels.name: update_product_screen
labels.description:
Edit an existing brand asset: name, description, kind, use_when,
and the screenshot tags (screen_type, device, theme).

labels.name: delete_product_screen
labels.description: Remove a product screenshot from Brand DNA. Does not delete Brand Memory.

labels.name: upload_logo
labels.description: Set the workspace logo in Brand DNA. Every render uses it.

labels.name: get_mascot
labels.description:
The workspace mascot: status (hero, keeping, frames, ready), the
hero picture, tries left, and every pose frame with its URL. Null
mascot = none yet.

labels.name: create_mascot
labels.description:
Start the brand mascot: from a description (note, kind) or from a
reference picture. Paid plans; 100 credits. Siren paints a hero in
about a minute; poll get_mascot, show the human, then mascot_step
keep (build the pose sheet) or retry (paint again, 3 tries). One
mascot per workspace.

labels.name: mascot_step
labels.description:
Move the mascot on: keep the hero, paint it again, or add a pose.
Ask the human before keep, since it builds the whole sheet.

labels.name: list_people
labels.description:
The people library: team faces Siren can put in stills (name,
role, team, status cropping or ready, round crop URL).

labels.name: add_person
labels.description:
Add a face to the people library. Siren crops it round in a few
seconds (status cropping, then ready). Only upload people who agreed.

labels.name: delete_person
labels.description: Remove a face from the people library.

labels.name: list_media
labels.description:
Photos and videos uploaded with upload_media, newest first, with
their URLs. Reuse a URL in create_campaign media or a film body.

labels.name: get_performance
labels.description:
How the posts did: totals (impressions, engagement, replies,
engagement rate) and the top posts with views, likes and replies.

labels.name: list_posts
labels.description:
Every post Siren sent or queued: platform, status, live URL, time,
and counts by status (posted, queued, failed).

labels.name: buy_credits
labels.description:
Get a Stripe checkout link for more credits. Give the link to the
human; they pay on Stripe and the credits land in about a minute.
Nothing is charged by this call. Read the balance on get_account.

labels.name: list_brand_videos
labels.description:
The brand's own clips in Brand DNA: name, what each shows, when to
use it, tags, best moments with timestamps, poster and scan_status.

labels.name: upload_brand_video
labels.description:
Add a product demo, walkthrough or footage to Brand DNA. With only
the file, Gemini reads frames across the clip and writes what it
shows, when to use it, tags and the best moments (scan_status
scanning, then ready in about 15 seconds; poll list_brand_videos).
Films play it when a brief names it ("l

labels.name: delete_brand_video
labels.description: Remove a clip from Brand DNA, file and poster included.

labels.name: delete_media
labels.description:
Delete one photo or video uploaded with upload_media. Only this
workspace's uploads; a film that already rendered keeps its copy.

labels.name: studio_templates
labels.description:
List Siren Studio's 33 React data-card types with family, description,
and body schema. Use this before studio_card so the body matches.

labels.name: studio_card
labels.description:
Render a Studio data card from a type + body. Deterministic React,
no paint. Optional live post after render. Returns run_id, image url,
and post url when posted.

labels.name: studio_automate
labels.description:
Create a Studio profile on this API key. Returns generate curl and
inbound hook URLs (Stripe, GitHub, Uptime Kuma, Product Hunt, generic).
Passing delivery.social_account_ids turns on social delivery for the
profile — that publishes, so it requires Allow posting.

labels.name: studio_schedule
labels.description: Render a Studio card then queue a ScheduledPost at scheduled_at.
